card.name: Word-start F after punctuation
card.fires_on: The letter F (or a word-start fragment like ref) that begins a word right after a colon, semicolon, or open bracket. Most often the F of 'Fetal Toxicity' in NSAID warning cross-references.

modes.label: Fetal Toxicity cross-reference
modes.description: The F that starts 'Fetal' after 'WARNINGS:' or 'WARNINGS;' in NSAID pregnancy warnings.

modes.label: Other F word starts
modes.description: An F that begins a name or acronym, such as a brand name or an abbreviation in brackets.

card.plain: It fires on a lone F that starts a word, mostly the F in 'Fetal Toxicity' in label cross-references.
